title: Rumored Refining
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Locate

Quest Description: Locate Not the Rumored Refinery in Algernon, find the S.T.I.L.L. device, drop a sample of Mined Fizz Rock in it,and report the results.

Quest Reward: 1750 gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Porthole Science

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Enter the Not the Rumored Refinery. While there, test some Mined Fizz Rock in the experimental S.T.I.L.L. A-LV. Report the results to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

We are getting reports that the Whiskers are creating a new kind of FizzStar. Apparently there have been complaints about the Fizz content of the FizzStar. It seems Whiskers are very Fizz conscious these days and have been asking for a diet version of FizzStar. But to make a new kind of FizzStar means a new refiner.

The Whiskers have comissioned such an experimental refiner from the Fade. They are calling the S.T.I.L.L. A-LV down in the cleverly named Not the Rumored Refinery. You know, that name really confused the guards here for, well, too long.

Anyway I need you to go down and test this experimental new refiner. We can't let Sissirat and Rattle Tooth get an even greater market share of the Energy Drink business. Get your hands on some more Mined Fizz Rock and see what happens when you use it in the refiner. With any luck the refiner is still very delicate and requires a light touch - which you seem to lack. Get down there and give the ol' Ham Hand!

When you have tested the refiner, report back to me, Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Turn-in:

Oh wow! I thought Fizz Rock smelt bad before, but wow! I guess when it explodes and sticks to a Dungeon Runner it really gets worse. Good work destroying their new refiner. It looks like it was a bit too experimental. Here, take this and hurry up, you're keeping my customers away.

Objectives:

  • Mining Pick ×1
  • Collected Fizz Rock Samples ×5
  • Results of S.T.I.L.L. AL-V Experiment ×1

Level range: 7–20
